sources.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: Redefining Agent Performance and Cost
sources.evidence: Dated October 19, 2026; announces M3.1 Flash availability through MiniMax API, M Plan and MiniMax Code. Its weights-will-follow statement describes launch-time availability.

sources.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash official model card
sources.evidence: Exact release card reports approximately 428B total and 23B activated parameters, native multimodal MoE, sparse attention throughout, image/video/text inputs and text output, 1M context, and a bundled DSpark draft head.

sources.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: MiniMaxM3SparseForConditionalGeneration; 60 text layers, 3 dense and 57 MoE, 128 routed experts with top-4 routing plus one shared expert; sparse attention in all layers. max_position_embeddings=1048576. Separate 32-layer vision configuration. Quantization specifies MXFP8 and NVFP4 routed experts.

sources.title: MiniMax Community License for M3.1-Flash
sources.evidence: Named MiniMax Community License, copyright 2026 MiniMax. Grants weight use and redistribution with conditions, including commercial attribution/notice requirements and prior authorization above its revenue threshold; not an unrestricted permissive license.

sources.title: Official M3.1-Flash checkpoint shard index
sources.evidence: Public index maps 89,632 tensor entries to 48 main-model safetensors shards. total_size is 250103411200 bytes, not a parameter count. Quantization scale entries are present.

sources.title: MiniMax Model Invocation documentation
sources.evidence: Exact API model ID MiniMax-M3.1-Flash; M-series model with 1,000,000 context, text/image/video input and low through max reasoning effort. Thinking cannot be disabled.

sources.title: Tool Use and Interleaved Thinking
sources.evidence: Examples explicitly use MiniMax-M3.1-Flash with tools schemas and tool_use/tool_calls responses. Supports reasoning between tool interactions; simple calls can omit reasoning content.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Repository is public and ungated at revision 262ae6830934f3512211081b8a3f16425b93a239. Lists 48 main shards and a separate dspark shard. safetensors total 220490854016 aggregates stored elements, mostly packed U8, and is not the learned parameter total. A pinned main-shard bytes=0-7 request returned HTTP 206 and exactly 8 bytes.

sources.title: MiniMax model release notes
sources.evidence: Lists MiniMax M3.1 Flash on October 19, 2026, linking the announcement.

sources.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention
sources.evidence: June 2026 paper linked from the exact M3.1-Flash card explains blockwise sparse attention built on GQA. Its 109B experimental model is not evidence for the October M3.1-Flash parameter count.

name.note: Exact public checkpoint name and API identifier; distinct from the earlier Preview identifier.

developer.note: Developer announcement and checkpoint copyright identify MiniMax.

family.note: Retains the catalog family key for MiniMax; the exact model is documented as part of its M-series.

release_date.note: Explicit general-availability announcement date. Later weight publication does not replace the model release date; earlier anonymous or Preview versions are distinct.

open_weights.note: Public, ungated checkpoint with 48 indexed main shards and DSpark files. A bounded HTTP 206 range probe verified access to a weight shard. The older launch text is superseded by the released repository.

license.note: Named custom weights license with commercial and use conditions; open_weights does not imply an OSI-style open-source license.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported approximate total in billions, not an exact tensor census. Packed NVFP4 U8 storage explains why Hugging Face stored-element metadata cannot be substituted. The card does not define the DSpark inclusion boundary.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal activated parameters per token. The card does not specify a component or phase convention; no total/active equality or checkpoint-derived active count is inferred.

architecture.note: Native multimodal Transformer MoE with MiniMax Sparse Attention throughout. Exact config confirms top-4 of 128 routed experts plus a shared expert in 57 layers, following 3 dense layers. The paper informs attention design, not this variant's size.

context_window.note: Retains the explicitly advertised API context of 1,000,000 tokens. The released checkpoint separately configures max_position_embeddings=1,048,576; this does not establish an increased hosted-API limit.

modalities.note: Native visual input is supported by the vision tower and image/video token configuration, not merely external file-to-text conversion. No image, video or audio generation is claimed.

reasoning.note: Reasoning effort ranges from low to max and cannot be disabled in the documented API. A simple tool-call turn can omit returned reasoning content.

tool_call.note: Exact-model examples provide callable function schemas and structured tool-call responses.

description.value: Native multimodal MoE model for coding and agentic tasks, with text, image and video inputs, text output, a 1M-token context window and adjustable reasoning effort.
description.note: Replaces promotional frontier wording with the documented architecture, modalities, context and reasoning controls.

patch.description: Native multimodal MoE model for coding and agentic tasks, with text, image and video inputs, text output, a 1M-token context window and adjustable reasoning effort.

sources.label: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: Redefining Agent Performance and Cost

patch.notes: Counts are MiniMax's nominal approximately 428B total and 23B active per token; the model card does not define the DSpark count boundary or active-component convention. Quantized stored-element totals are not parameter totals. API/card context is 1,000,000 tokens; checkpoint max_position_embeddings is 1,048,576. Public weights use the conditional MiniMax Community License.

summary: Confirmed all 14 fields against exact-model primary evidence. Corrects closed-weights status, adds the named license, nominal 428B/23B counts and MoE architecture, and makes the description factual. Keeps October 19 release and 1,000,000 API context, separately noting 1,048,576 checkpoint positions. No full weights were downloaded or executed; only metadata and an 8-byte HTTP 206 weight probe were used. Count component conventions remain unspecified by the developer.
